title: Can automations be set from a Slack message?
summary: A Buddy can create and enable its own automation from any conversation, including channel/Slack threads, without schedule.manage when within guardrails; scheduling another Buddy still requires that grant. Implementation is integrated on current main. The separate requested FIFO cap for Buddy responses is also integrated. The canonical self-scheduling Task remains in review pending owner live-runtime verification, so release/runtime activation is unconfirmed; no unrelated or parked ask was found.
nextAction: Product Development Lead/owner: after confirming the running backend has reloaded, ask a Buddy in a channel thread to create an hourly self-automation and verify it is enabled in its Automations page; then update/close the existing Task. Confirm FIFO behavior live only if its separate acceptance remains in scope.
